request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I cancel my electricity contract because of the price increase?

response.text:
Ordnung has not calculated a specific deadline for this special cancellation right — only the regular notice-period date is stored for your electricity contract.

- The letter says (laut dem Schreiben) you have a special right to cancel under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG because of the price increase, and that your cancellation must arrive before the price change takes effect — the letter states this effective date as "01.11.2026" [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e]. This is only in the letter text, not a date Ordnung has verified or computed as a deadline, so please check it against the paper letter.
- Ordnung's own computed exit date for this contract (under the normal notice rule, not the price-increase special right) is: cancellation must arrive by Fri 2 Oct 2026 for the contract to end Mon 2 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].
- The only related to-do stored is the increased advance payment of 54.00 € due Sun 15 Nov 2026 [item:itm_v3m35j0h5pwv], not a cancellation deadline.

Since the special-right deadline itself isn't in Ordnung's record, I'd suggest checking the letter's exact wording yourself and, if in doubt about timing, confirming with Stadtwerke Musterstadt or a consumer advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale) before it lapses.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

Preisbestandteil   bisher (brutto)   ab 01.11.2026 (brutto)

von 48,00 € auf 54,00 € an.

Wirksamwerdens der Preisänderung in Textform zu kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 Energiewirtschaftsgesetz
